item.title: Proofless Access — CyberPulse Daily (2026-11-11)
item.dc:creator: Tushar Vartak
item.description: Verification gaps dominated today’s risk: unsigned or redirect‑bypassed identity flows, a repository SSO revocation gap, an in‑the‑wild browser fix, active exploitation of Brotli and Metabase, and a patch wave with critical preview‑pane and identity components. Actions: enforce signed assertions, accelerate click‑less patches, and tighten package governance.
